features.statement: Primary and secondary call-to-action buttons are fully rounded pills, in filled or outlined variants.
Cards and buttons use modest small-to-medium corner radii alongside pill shapes.
Product listings appear as a multi-column grid of thin-bordered cards with bold names and accent-colored prices.
Cards are separated by thin light borders rather than box shadows, giving a flat look.
Icons are absent as SVGs; utility actions like search, cart, login and social links are plain text labels.
A colored announcement bar with centered white text sits at the very top of the page.
A light utility bar above the header holds contact details on the left and social links on the right.
Header is a single horizontal row: logo left, centered navigation links, account links right.
Dropdown navigation items show only a caret indicator, with no submenu visible in the static state.
The H1 is a large hero headline (about 67px) rather than the brand name.
Section headings are moderate in size and light weight, keeping a restrained heading scale.
Entire page uses a single clean sans-serif font stack consistently across all elements.
Body copy is muted grey, centered in narrow columns, with generous line height.
Palette is teal-centric, with several teal shades, slate text and pale mint tints.
Sections alternate between white, pale mint and dark teal full-width bands for visual rhythm.
A full-width dark band features white text, a light first line, a bold second line and a white pill button.
Category icons appear as a centered row of four white cards on a pale tinted band, each with icon and label.
Engagement blocks are three bordered cards with accent-colored titles and outlined pill buttons.
Sections end with explicit call-to-action buttons beneath short intro paragraphs.
Footer has a dark background with light text in four columns with h4 headings.
Newsletter signup is an email input joined to an accent-colored Subscribe button.
Payment method icons are shown in a compact horizontal row.
Legal disclaimer and copyright sit below a thin divider line in small, light text.
Content is centered in a fixed-width container (about 1140px) with consistent side margins.
Layout is built with flexbox and grid containers.
Page is compact and short, with few sections and little repeated content.
Markup uses semantic nav and section elements.
Heading hierarchy is irregular, starting at h3 and skipping levels, with product titles as h3 under an h2.
DOM is lean, with minimal scripts, meta tags, few classes and no utility-framework classes.
Page title pairs brand name with a benefit-oriented tagline.
Product cards show text only, with no product imagery.
Copy has no emoji and uses a restrained, warm and direct tone.
